reason: The corrected invoice (event-22, corrected-plumbing-invoice.pdf) now has the right address and the right provider, so the earlier postcode problem (event-19, event-20) is resolved. It still can't be passed on or closed. It shows no amount, no VAT, no completion date and no itemisation. There is no quote in the case and no approval for any amount: the landlord's only approval (event-3) was for "maintenance works" generally. The case also contains no completion confirmation from the provider or the tenant, and nothing on whether the spare key was returned (event-15, event-16). The tenant's drawer defect (event-12) has had no reply. The boiler matter raised on the call (event-21) isn't part of this job, and I promised to check it. I am asking the provider for an itemised invoice, completion date, quote and key return. Escalation isn't needed, because the provider can supply these facts. Once I have them I can route the invoice to the landlord for approval, or ask the landlord if the amount is above the approved sum. Nothing can be paid or closed until then.
message: Hello Ivo, thank you for the corrected invoice NBL-025-INV-15. The postcode now matches 18 Thistlewick Row. Before we can pass it to the landlord, please send an itemised invoice that shows: (1) the total amount, with VAT shown separately, and the cost of the tap and of labour; (2) the date you attended and completed the tap replacement at 18 Thistlewick Row; (3) confirmation that the spare key has been returned to our office. We have no quote on file for this job, so please send any quote you gave. The invoice does not show a price. Nothing can be paid until we have this. Separately, we will check the boiler matter you mentioned with the relevant engineer. It is not part of this tap job. Kind regards, Tessa Wren, Northbridge Lettings
unknowns: Completion date and confirmation of work done
Whether the spare key was returned
Boiler matter: what work, if any, was done
options: Wait for the itemised invoice, then route to landlord for approval
Escalate if the provider cannot supply a quote or itemisation
request: The kitchen mixer tap is constantly dripping and wasting water. The water looks cloudy when I fill a glass. I suspect limescale may be involved and would like to know whether a new tap could be considered.
unrelated_issues: Tenant reports a loose top kitchen drawer with snapped metal front brackets (event-12), which needs its own request.
Boiler matter mentioned by the contractor on the call (event-21): I said I would check with the relevant engineer. It is not documented as part of this job.
